scope: Paired fixed-contract deals, four focal seats per deal; tests discard/play, not auction strength or human win rate.
interval_method: Approximate 95% normal interval over per-deal mean differences (clustered seat rotations).
notes: The advanced comparison is a small sample, its interval includes zero; it does not establish a reliable overall strength advantage.
The two comparisons use different opponents and their score improvements should not be compared with each other.
Time-bounded search completes a hardware-dependent number of samples, so repeated runs may differ.
Both comparisons cycle Prise, Garde, Jiedi, Garde sans and Garde contre.
